description: This Java class defines a custom GLSurfaceView for an OpenGL ES rendering context on Android, handling touch events to rotate objects rendered via OpenGL.

classes.name: MyGLSurfaceView
classes.description: A custom GLSurfaceView that manages an OpenGL ES 2.0 rendering context and handles touch interactions to rotate the displayed object.

methods.name: MyGLSurfaceView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GLSurfaceView, setting the OpenGL context, renderer, and render mode.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to update the rotation angle of the 3D object based on user input.
